scope: All staged branch/PR refs and mapped tag refs in the namespaced imports; each unique referenced Git tree is inventoried once, with ref-to-commit/tree mappings. The existing per-source tip inventories remain available. Original bundles are outside this worktree.

category_dispositions.licenses: RETAIN under each source's legacy prefix as source notices; do not infer a new combined license grant.
category_dispositions.state: HISTORICAL_ONLY; do not activate or merge into Harness Rig runtime state.
category_dispositions.hooks: HISTORICAL_ONLY; do not install or register from the imported prefixes.
category_dispositions.host_plugin_manifests: HISTORICAL_ONLY; do not load as active host configuration.
category_dispositions.install_update: HISTORICAL_ONLY; do not execute imported installers or migration scripts.
category_dispositions.generated_distribution: HISTORICAL_ONLY; do not publish as Harness Rig output. The imported TacticSwitch main tip has a stale MANIFEST.sha256; recalculating it in a disposable copy made its unchanged 200-test gate pass, but the source ref remains unchanged.
category_dispositions.schemas_contracts: HISTORICAL_ONLY; adopted semantics require their separate Harness Rig specifications and dispositions.
category_dispositions.tests_evals: HISTORICAL_ONLY in the imported tree; only separately invoked legacy checks count as qualification evidence.
category_dispositions.ci: HISTORICAL_ONLY; imported workflows do not become active Harness Rig CI.
category_dispositions.openspec: HISTORICAL_ONLY; imported change archives do not become active Harness Rig authority.
category_dispositions.agent_roles: HISTORICAL_ONLY; source skills and agent instructions are not installed by importing history.
category_dispositions.unclassified_paths: HISTORICAL_ONLY pending per-surface admission; no unclassified path is activated by these staged refs.
category_dispositions.tags_and_signatures: Original source bundles remain available outside this worktree; all 21 mapped source tag objects (13 annotated, 8 lightweight) were confirmed against their source refs. None of the annotated tags has an embedded signature. Rewritten commit signatures and annotated tag objects are not preserved; local commit-signature verification was blocked by unavailable GPG keyring/public keys and missing SSH allowed-signers configuration. Keep final fidelity acceptance blocked; see verification/m11-object-fidelity-audit.json.

acceptance_gaps: The source refs remain staged in namespaces; no import-only commits were accepted. Import-only verification is explicitly NOT_RUN because no such commits exist; see verification/m11-import-only-status.json.
TacticSwitch legacy quality gate has one failing checksum test out of 200 on the unchanged source snapshot.
Source commit signatures and annotated tag objects are not preserved by the rewrite; preserve the selected fidelity hard gate until demonstrated.

history_ref_inventory.method: Inventory all unique trees reachable from the staged branch/PR/tag refs using the existing M11 path classifier; retain ref mapping and classified/unclassified paths.
history_ref_inventory.coverage: Every path in each inventoried tree is assigned to a classifier category or explicitly listed as unclassified.
